## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- merchantShearAngle
- returns ~25° for typical steel (µ=0.5, α=6°)
- increases with higher rake angle
- decreases with higher friction
- clamps to [5, 45] range
- satisfies Merchant formula: φ = π/4 - β/2 + α/2
